description: This file implements webhook security and signature verification for multiple telecommunication services (Twilio, Plivo, Telnyx). It includes functions for validating signatures, reconstructing URLs, and managing replay caches to prevent replay attacks.

methods.name: sha256Hex
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 hash of input string and returns hex digest.

methods.name: createSkippedVerificationReplayKey
methods.description: Creates a replay key for skipped verification based on provider and request context.

methods.name: pruneReplayCache
methods.description: Removes expired or excess entries from the replay cache.

methods.name: markReplay
methods.description: Marks a replay in the cache; returns true if the replay was already seen.

methods.name: validateTwilioSignature
methods.description: Validates Twilio webhook signature using HMAC-SHA1.

methods.name: buildTwilioDataToSign
methods.description: Builds the string to sign for Twilio webhook validation.

methods.name: buildCanonicalTwilioParamString
methods.description: Builds a canonical string of URL parameters for signature validation.

methods.name: timingSafeEqual
methods.description: Performs timing-safe comparison of two strings.

methods.name: reconstructWebhookUrl
methods.description: Reconstructs the webhook URL from request headers with security validation.

methods.name: buildTwilioVerificationUrl
methods.description: Builds the verification URL based on context and optional public URL.

methods.name: isLoopbackAddress
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: stripPortFromUrl
methods.description: Removes port from a URL string.

methods.name: setPortOnUrl
methods.description: Sets a specific port on a URL string.

methods.name: extractPortFromHostHeader
methods.description: Extracts port number from a host header string.

methods.name: createTwilioReplayKey
methods.description: Creates a replay key for Twilio requests.

methods.name: decodeBase64OrBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64 or base64url encoded string into a Buffer.

methods.name: base64UrlEncode
methods.description: Encodes a Buffer into a base64url string.

methods.name: importEd25519PublicKey
methods.description: Imports an Ed25519 public key from PEM or base64 format.

methods.name: verifyTelnyxWebhook
methods.description: Verifies Telnyx webhook signature using Ed25519 and checks timestamp skew.

methods.name: verifyTwilioWebhook
methods.description: Verifies Twilio webhook signature with URL reconstruction and fallback URL variants.

methods.name: createPlivoV2ReplayKey
methods.description: Creates a replay key for Plivo V2 signatures.

methods.name: createPlivoV3ReplayKey
methods.description: Creates a replay key for Plivo V3 signatures.

methods.name: validatePlivoV2Signature
methods.description: Validates Plivo V2 signature.

methods.name: validatePlivoV3Signature
methods.description: Validates Plivo V3 signature.

methods.name: verifyPlivoWebhook
methods.description: Verifies Plivo webhook signature, supporting V2 and V3 algorithms.
